title: Architectural Design Records Generation
short_description: Evaluation of Large Language Models' capability to generate Architectural Design Records from decision contexts
long_description: An empirical study exploring the feasibility of using Large Language Models (LLMs) for generating Architecture Decision Records (ADRs). The study evaluates different approaches including zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning to generate ADR Decisions from given Contexts. This research addresses the challenge of slow ADR adoption in software development by investigating how LLMs can assist in automating the documentation of architectural decisions, promoting better Architectural Knowledge Management (AKM).
